All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I hand-checked T11, T12 and T13 against the data, and they match. T1–T10 and T14 I only eyeballed against the files.

Two things to know about the queries:
- **Keywords:** map keys come out as keywords, so T8 and T13 turn them back into text with `print | drop 1`.
- **Missing fields:** T1, T3, T4 and T6 read optional fields softly with `at` and `coalesce`. `allOf` doesn't short-circuit, so the strict `/email` read failed on a null email in my first try at T1.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf (at :active | eq true) (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)
T4: /data/users | map ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(type | ne ::null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)})
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | type | ne ::null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)
T8: :dev /devDependencies | /dependencies | union dev | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | map ~([(/0 | print | drop 1) /1] | join "@")
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) | map ~(count)
T11: lines | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map ~({:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))}) | filter ~(/s | eq "shipped") | map ~(/t) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map ~({:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))}) | filter ~(/s | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/t) | sum) | entries | map ~({:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total (/1 | round 2)}) | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
